speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg. To help narrow down the cause, how long has this pain been present, and would you describe the radiation as sharp, burning, or numbness?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression). Given the sudden onset after exercise and radiation to the foot, I suspect an acute herniated disc. Please confirm if you experienced any recent heavy lifting or twisting motions that preceded the pain.
